name: church-translator
description: Real-time English to Spanish translation for church services using OpenAI Realtime Translation API

scripts.build:client: mkdir -p dist/client/js dist/client/css && cp src/client/js/*.js dist/client/js/ && cp src/client/css/*.css dist/client/css/ && cp src/client/*.html src/client/sw.js src/client/manifest.json dist/client/
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
